posts.name: armadagon
posts.cooked: An early misclick nearly cost me my Mint.  Accidentially used Localized Hurricane's second power to destroy itself the turn after it came into play.  Because of that, the game was significantly dragged out far longer than it needed to be.  Ended up having to let Omnitron heal back to full from ~20 while recovering and building back up under a Meteor Storm.  Got slammed with Flechettes/Singularity back-to-back more than once.  The second time it happened, I was able to retaliate with Fueled Freeze for 2 components and Adaptive Plating, followed by External Combustion to wipe his board in return.  It was a pretty brutal slug fest, but no one died.  Though we were really dicy for a bit.  I would have lost if the Environment didn't flip a third Meteor Storm after it's reshuffle, since there was an EPE at 7 health, 2 of each drone, and a rail gun in play while everyone except Wraith was in single digits.

Hooray for the smaller file size!

Mint. Nothing much to report, just a fairly standard Omnitron game. Got Tech singularity'd once. Interpolation beam came back regularly, but that just made it so I didn't use Hurricane.

Actually used Locomotion to get ride of an Adaptive plating Subroutine. I couldn't manage to keep the Omni Cannon in play long enough to use it.

Fire in the Biosphere translated into a lot of damage to Omni,  since zero had the transducer and Coolant Blast in play.

Terra forming the red dust into a Tech singularity was a dirty trick. "Here's your stuff back. Now Imma blow it all up." Bad robot! NO OILCAN FOR YOU!
